title: Adverse gradient: separation onset and a data-generated threshold

modelComponents.integrator: drift → pair collisions → walls → bodies, velocity-Verlet kicks when forces present /1
modelComponents.openBoundaries: reservoir-boundary/1 (kinetic flux, optional velocity profile; A-18)

geometry: 400 × 80, diffuse plate on [40, 380], open far-field top
wallModel: segmented floor (diffuse plate), reservoir inlet/outlet, generator 'far-field'

reynolds.note: Re_sim = ρ_e U_e L_plate / μ with the realised upstream ρ_e, U_e (first plate station, s = 0); μ from results/viscosity_reference.json (base: φ=0.1, H=40, U=0.5, Aw=1, Couette μ_eff, 0.2.0-p0.2). Re_x at separation onset: no onset.

mach.note: Mp = U_e/c_p upstream, c_p from results/sound-speed_sweeps.json (A φ=0.1, 0.2.0-p0.2) (measured at the stated, not the realised, density)

emptySpace.note: Master prompt §20: occupancy and density extremes on cells of ~40 particles; a cell below 0.1 φ_mean in 5 consecutive samples flags POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE. Low density near open boundaries (A-18) is expected and is not near-zero occupancy.

thresholdHypotheses.note: no separated training configuration: no threshold can be generated
no separated training configuration: no threshold can be generated

uncertainty.note: τ_w: seed ensemble per station; fields: seed-averaged; thresholds: spread over training configurations.

benchmarks.note: None used. Classical separation criteria (e.g. shape-factor or Thwaites-type values) are NOT used to define onset or thresholds.

acceptance.description: No run halted by the safety monitor

Momentum ledger incl. open-boundary fluxes closes

acceptance.criterion: no POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE flag

acceptance.description: At least one configuration separates, so a threshold can be studied
Separated configurations exist in both the training and the test set
acceptance.criterion: ≥ 1 separated training and ≥ 1 separated test configuration

viscosity.source: results/viscosity_reference.json (base: φ=0.1, H=40, U=0.5, Aw=1, Couette μ_eff, 0.2.0-p0.2)
